title: Organization
description: A number of people organized into a community or other social, commercial, or political structure. The group has a common goal or raison d'être that transcends its individual members and can act as an agent. An organization often has a hierarchical structure.

alternativeName.description: Other name by which the organization is known. For example commercial name, informal name…. Lijst van LanguageString items.

contactInfo.description: Information such as email, telephone... that allows the Organisation to be contacted. Lijst van ContactInfo items.

type.description: Type of organization. Specialization of classification (besides activity & status). Lijst van OrganizationType items.
